paths.name: one-prompt-venture-launch
verifiedAssertions: No workspace or provider call occurs before command and Launch Grant authorization.
Company resources remain owned by the granting organization.
The generated venture identity, app shell, ServiceBlueprint, connector manifest, and Agent Surface are venture-specific.
Advertising spend is never authorized by a Launch Grant.
Fixture effects require provider read-back and replay without duplicate effects.
paths.liveLimit: The repository, provider accounts, preview, and production deployment are fixture evidence only.

paths.name: recursive-saas-service
verifiedAssertions: Cross-operator, cross-venture, and cross-customer connection, credential, resource, webhook, run, and grant access fails closed.
Subscription, entitlement, Service Grant, Agent Grant, command scope, and authorization envelope are independently required.
One venture-specific command and its read-back reconciliation contract behave identically on direct, REST, CLI, MCP, SDK, and UI surfaces.
Unknown provider outcomes retain usage headroom; reconciliation completes by read-back without repeating the original effect.
Offboarding revokes access while preserving customer-owned resource records.
paths.liveLimit: All users, organizations, credentials, provider outputs, and resources are synthetic fixtures.

paths.name: winner-loop-fixture-d
verifiedAssertions: The trace contains exactly 34 ordered milestones.
The command audit contains 70 records and verifies its chain.
Six provider lifecycle operations use a full organization-plus-venture TenantRef and remain fixture-only with no external effect or spend.
Creative ledger, manifest, evidence, subscription, spend, and paid-test state are durable and require trusted ownership mapping for legacy adoption.
Metric, baseline, evaluation, attribution, cohort, and learning records preserve tenant and source lineage.
The first-party event pack is explicitly installed and enabled before recording.
paths.liveLimit: No creative provider, social network, ad platform, attribution provider, or RevenueCat project was contacted.

paths.name: fleet-upgrade
verifiedAssertions: The canary completes before the next batch.
Same-slug ventures in different company organizations keep independent leases, checkpoints, hooks, and replay state.
Venture-owned design and ServiceBlueprint files remain unchanged.
Non-overlapping merge-managed changes are combined and overlapping edits fail closed.
A failed canary pauses the fleet, restores the canary, and never starts the batch.
Production and compensation require an exact versioned health read-back for the same target.
Already deployed ventures remain healthy when the Fleet Controller store is closed, and a replacement controller reconciles completed effects without re-applying them.
paths.liveLimit: Branch creation, preview deployment, merge, production deployment, and smoke checks use labelled fixture hooks.
